query: What is the tax rate on IT export services for PSEB registered exporters?
ground_truth: 0.25% of proceeds under Section 154A and Division IVA of Part III of the First Schedule for persons registered with the Pakistan Software Export Board, for tax years 2024 up to 2029.

query: freelancer ki IT export income pe tax kitna lagta hai agar PSEB registered ho?
ground_truth: 0.25% of export proceeds under Section 154A for PSEB registered persons, for tax years 2024 up to 2029; any other case is 1% of proceeds.

query: IT export proceeds par withholding tax kitna hai agar PSEB mein registered na ho?
ground_truth: 1% of proceeds, the rate for any other case in Division IVA of Part III of the First Schedule.

query: پی ایس ای بی رجسٹرڈ آئی ٹی ایکسپورٹر پر کتنا ٹیکس ہے؟
ground_truth: 0.25% of export proceeds under Section 154A for tax years 2024 up to 2029.

query: What was the tax rate on export of IT services under section 154A in January 2021?
ground_truth: One percent of the proceeds of the export, the Division IVA rate before it was substituted by the Finance Act, 2022.

query: What surcharge must a person pay to enter the active taxpayers list after filing a late return?
ground_truth: Under Section 182A: one hundred thousand rupees for a company, fifty thousand for an association of persons and twenty-five thousand for an individual.

query: agar return late file ki to individual ko active taxpayer list mein aane ke liye kitna surcharge dena hoga?
ground_truth: Twenty-five thousand rupees for an individual under Section 182A.

query: Under which provision is super tax on high earning persons imposed and at what rates?
ground_truth: Section 4C imposes super tax for tax year 2022 and onwards at the rates in Division IIB of Part I of the First Schedule.

query: What is the withholding tax rate for local IT and IT enabled services under Section 153?
ground_truth: 4% for persons on the Active Taxpayers List and 8% for others, under Section 153(1)(b).

query: What is the withholding tax on rent if an individual receives Rs. 500,000 a year?
ground_truth: 5% of the gross amount exceeding Rs. 300,000, which is Rs. 10,000, under Section 155.

query: bank ke profit pe filer aur non filer ka kitna tax katega?
ground_truth: 20% for persons on the Active Taxpayers List and 40% for others under Section 151.

query: What is the advance tax on sale of property worth up to Rs. 50 million under section 236C?
ground_truth: 2.75% for persons on the Active Taxpayers List and 11.50% for others.

query: non filer ke cash withdrawal par kitna advance tax hai?
ground_truth: 0.80% under Section 231AB for a person not appearing in the Active Taxpayers List.

query: What rate applies to export proceeds under section 154(1)?
ground_truth: 1.25% under Division IV of Part III of the First Schedule.

query: What withholding tax applies to dividends paid by Independent Power Purchasers?
ground_truth: 7.50% for persons on the Active Taxpayers List and 15.00% for others under Section 150.

query: What is the standard rate of federal sales tax?
ground_truth: Eighteen per cent of the value of taxable supplies and imported goods under Section 3 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

query: sales tax ka normal rate kya hai Pakistan mein?
ground_truth: Eighteen per cent under Section 3 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

query: Are exported goods charged to sales tax?
ground_truth: They are charged at zero per cent under Section 4 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

query: Must a manufacturer register for sales tax?
ground_truth: Yes. Under Section 14 a manufacturer making taxable supplies who is not running a cottage industry must be registered.

query: What is the penalty for issuing a simulated or fictitious sales tax invoice?
ground_truth: A penalty equal to the face value of the invoice, under S. No. 29 of the Section 33 table; the person is also placed on a public simulated invoice issuers register.

query: جعلی سیلز ٹیکس انوائس جاری کرنے پر کیا جرمانہ ہے؟
ground_truth: A penalty equal to the face value of the simulated or fictitious invoice under Section 33, S. No. 29.

query: Can a buyer claim input tax on agricultural machinery taxed at 7% under the Eighth Schedule?
ground_truth: No. Section 8 disallows input tax on import or purchase of agricultural machinery or equipment subject to sales tax at 7% under the Eighth Schedule.

query: What is the Punjab sales tax rate on hotels?
ground_truth: Sixteen percent, except five percent without input tax adjustment for non-corporate, non-franchise, non-chain businesses with less than 20 rooms.

query: Punjab mein marriage hall pe kitna sales tax hai?
ground_truth: Five percent without input tax adjustment under the Second Schedule, tariff heading 9801.3000.

query: What is the Punjab sales tax rate on club membership services?
ground_truth: Sixteen percent under the Second Schedule, tariff heading 9801.4000.

query: Who must register under the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act?
ground_truth: Under Section 25, a person providing a taxable service from an office or place of business in Punjab, a person otherwise required to register under the Act or rules, or one meeting criteria prescribed by the Authority.

query: How long can an exporter retain export proceeds in foreign currency with an Authorized Dealer?
ground_truth: Three working days from receipt of funds by the Authorized Dealer, under Para 7 of Chapter 12 of the Foreign Exchange Manual.

query: Within how many days must the export value of goods be received in Pakistan?
ground_truth: On the due date for payment or within 120 days from the date of shipment under Para 6 of Chapter 12; up to 180 days where export bills are discounted and sold forward as specified.

query: freelancer apne ESFCA account mein kitne dollars rakh sakta hai?
ground_truth: USD 5,000 per month or 50% of export proceeds, whichever is higher, under Para 12 of Chapter 12.

query: Who counts as a freelancer under the State Bank's foreign exchange rules?
ground_truth: Individuals resident in Pakistan providing digital or online services, including IT and IT related services, against payments received from outside Pakistan.

query: Do companies need State Bank approval to remit dividends to non-resident shareholders?
ground_truth: No. Authorized Dealers may allow it without prior State Bank approval through an Authorized Dealer designated by the company, under Para 16 of Chapter 14.

query: Who can open a Foreign Currency Value Account?
ground_truth: Under Para 8A of Chapter 6, including individual non-resident Pakistanis, non-residents holding a Pakistan Origin Card, and resident Pakistani individuals who declared assets held abroad in their latest tax return.

query: Is there any restriction on receiving remittances from abroad?
ground_truth: No. Para 2 of Chapter 10 places no restriction on receipt of remittances from abroad, in foreign currency or by debit to non-resident Rupee accounts of banks' overseas branches or correspondents.

query: What must be enclosed with half yearly statements of foreign exchange receipts?
ground_truth: Encashment certificates from Authorized Dealers supporting the foreign exchange received from abroad, under Para 2 of Chapter 21.

query: Which option do I choose in IRIS to file a normal income tax return?
ground_truth: Under Declaration select Returns/Statements (Original), then Normal Return (Ind/AOP/COY).

query: IRIS mein salary kahan enter karni hai?
ground_truth: On the Data tab, click Employment and enter annual income under Pay, Wages or Other Remuneration (including Arrears of Salary), then click Calculate.

query: When is the IRIS return process complete regarding reconciliation?
ground_truth: Only when the Unreconciled Amount is adjusted to 0.

query: How do I create the tax payment in IRIS?
ground_truth: From Tax Chargeable/Payments open Computations, copy the Admitted Income Tax amount and click Prepare PSID to create the payment.

query: When does the Finance Act, 2026 come into force?
ground_truth: Unless otherwise provided, on the first day of July, 2026.

query: What motor vehicle tax does the Finance Act 2026 set in Islamabad for cars up to 1000 cc?
ground_truth: Rs. 20,000 lifetime in Table 2 of the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act schedule as amended by Section 2.

query: What change did the Finance Act 2026 make to Serial No. 3 in section 10 of the Finance Act, 2018?
ground_truth: The figure 600 was substituted with 200 in column (3).

query: What customs duty does the Finance Act 2026 set for PCT code 2207.2000?
ground_truth: 30% for ethyl alcohol and other spirits, denatured, of any strength.

query: PCT code 1201.1010 par customs duty kitni hai?
ground_truth: 0% for seed for sowing, under the First Schedule of the Finance Act, 2026.

query: When did the Income Tax Rules, 2002 come into force?
ground_truth: On the first day of July, 2002, except rules 3 to 9, which apply to income earned on or after a separately specified date.

query: Which entertainment expenditure is deductible under the Income Tax Rules?
ground_truth: Under Rule 10: expenditure outside Pakistan in connection with business transactions, in Pakistan on foreign customers and suppliers, on customers and clients at the business premises, and at meetings of shareholders, agents and directors, among others.
